entities.name: Dobéhma
entities.description: A human women-only race with lilac-colored hair from Dominaria.

entities.name: Vetro
entities.description: Neo-Ebonic priest-king who thought himself Tourach incarnate; killed by his slave-wife.

events.summary: According to myth, Vetro was killed by his slave-wife, who fled with her daughters and was cursed to bear only girls.
events.quote: His slave-wife killed him and their sons and fled with her daughters.

relations.note: A notable Dobéhma is the planeswalker Vram.
relations.quote: A notable Dobéhma is the planeswalker Vram
